description: Provider-agnostic PHP audit log library: contracts, audit entry model, attributes and histories. Doctrine ORM support lives in auditor-doctrine-provider, Symfony integration in auditor-bundle.
rules: Since auditor 5.0 the Doctrine ORM provider is the separate package damienharper/auditor-doctrine-provider; Symfony applications install damienharper/auditor-bundle.
Entry::$extraData is already decoded (?array): never call json_decode() on it.
LifecycleEvent payloads have no 'action' key: read the operation from $payload['type'].
Entry::$transactionHash no longer exists in 5.x: use Entry::$transactionId (a ULID).
